blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Requested-value control is stricter than continuous steering: given $c$ on a human-rating scale, the generated image should attain that value from only limited ratings. We present ScoreDial, which fits a differentiable regressor $R$ to 100-479 human-rated images; once $R$ is fixed, a requested value $c$ is defined on its output scale, and learned target conditioning is paired with error-adaptive guidance that repeatedly reduces $|R(\mathbf{x})-c|$ during sampling. Across tire slip resistance, interior visual complexity, food desire-to-eat, and soap translucency, using one set of sampler settings shared across all four, ScoreDial reaches requested values and achieves, on all four attributes, $R$-MAE at most 0.013 over a range of width 0.8 and Spearman $ρ=0.980$, the maximum attainable under our evaluation protocol. Because $R$ also drives sampling, we evaluate agreement with $R$ separately from matched sweeps, an independent auditor fitted to the same ratings on a backbone none of the deployed regressors uses, and blinded human judgments. MPGD-flow also reaches the requested values under $R$, but ScoreDial has larger auditor displacement on every attribute, the largest among all compared methods, and a stronger MPGD-flow setting gives up target agreement without closing this gap. On every attribute, removing target conditioning leaves low $R$-MAE but more than halves auditor displacement, separating precise score correction from attribute movement. Blinded rating studies with 15 raters per attribute show that mean human ratings track $c$ on tire and soap, with linear $R^2=0.665$ and $R^2=0.786$, and in forced-choice comparisons of matched sweeps, raters chose ScoreDial's as the clearer progression in at least 84% of judgments against every baseline.
blocks.zh: 要求的数值控制比连续方向更严格:如果按人定级计算,生成的图像只能从有限的评级中获得这一数值。 我们提出的是分数Dial,它符合一个不同的递归器,相当于100-479美元;一旦确定美元,就在其输出尺度上定义了要求的美元,所学习的目标条件与在取样时反复减少美元R(\mathb{x})-c|的适应错误的指南对齐。 在轮胎滑动阻力、内视复杂度、食物欲食性和肥皂半透明性方面,使用所有四个国家共享的一套采样器设置,计分仪达到所要求的值,并在所有四个属性上达到最大0.013雷亚尔的MAE,宽度为0.8,斯皮尔曼为0.980美元,这是我们评价协议下可达到的最高值。 由于R$也驱动着抽样,我们评价与R$的协议与匹配的扫荡分开,独立审计员在部署的倒退者没有使用过的骨干上达到同样的评级,以及蒙蔽人类判断。 MPGD流量也达到要求值的R$,但ScoreDial在每个属性上都有较大的审计人员置换,是所有比较方法中最大的一个,更强大的MPGD流量设置在不弥补这一缺口的情况下放弃了目标协议. 在每个属性上,去除目标条件会留下较低的R$-MAE,但超过一半的审计员置换,将精确的分数校正与属性运动区分开来. 盲目评级研究,每个属性有15个评分,显示人类的评分轨迹为轮胎和肥皂,线性为R^2=0.665美元和R^2=0.786美元,在强制选择对匹配的扫射进行比较时,评分者选择ScoreDial's作为至少84%的判断比每个基线更清晰的进展.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual appearance influences how products are perceived and evaluated [ 3 , 11 ] . Such judgments concern perceived attributes of an appearance [ 11 ] , and collecting consumer evaluations at scale can be expensive [ 4 ] . Generative models can automate the creation of design images [ 4 , 37 ] , but useful control may require more than asking for an attribute to become “more” or “less” pronounced: the desired outcome can be a particular numeric level [ 6 , 8 , 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 视觉外观影响产品如何被认识和评价[3,11]. 此类判决涉及一种外表的可感知属性[11],收集规模的消费者评价可能代价高昂[4]。 基因模型可以使设计图像的生成自动化[4,37],但有用的控制可能要求的不仅仅是要求属性成为"更"或"更小"的发音:所期望的结果可以是特定的数值级[6,8,27].

blocks.en: We study requested-value control of task-specific human-rated attributes from only a few hundred rated images. Continuous conditional generators are developed in label-rich settings and condition on scalar regression labels [ 13 , 15 , 16 , 8 , 43 ] , but sampling is open-loop to realized label error: the current sample’s discrepancy is not measured and fed back. Slider methods expose a continuous strength or direction [ 18 , 19 , 2 , 7 , 40 , 39 ] , not a requested value calibrated to a task-specific human-rating scale. Other controls derive attributes from image statistics, classifiers, or vision–language models [ 6 , 43 ] ; Hu et al. describe CLIPScore as “unreliable and often inaccurate” for text–image faithfulness [ 26 ] . Our setting combines limited human ratings with a numeric request on that scale.
blocks.zh: 我们只研究几百个标定的图像 对特定任务的人标定属性的要求值控制 持续有条件的生成器是在标签丰富的设置和标尺回归标签的条件[13, 15, 16, 8, 43]中被开发出来的,但采样是开放的去向到已实现的标签错误:当前样本的差异没有被测量并反馈. 滑行法暴露出一个连续的强度或方向[18,19,2,7,40,39],而不是要求的数值被校正到特定任务的人造分级. 其他控制来自图像统计、分类器或视觉语言模型[6、43]; Hu等将CLIPScore描述为"不可靠且往往不准确"的文本-图像忠实性[26]. 我们的设定结合了有限的人类收视率和这个尺度上的数字要求.

blocks.en: ScoreDial turns those ratings into a closed-loop generator. A frozen pretrained visual backbone and a linear ridge head fitted to the human ratings form the differentiable regressor R R , while a pretrained diffusion model is adapted to each image domain. Target conditioning , trained jointly with the domain LoRA on R R -pseudo-labeled images, injects c c into every transformer block and positions generation open-loop. Error-adaptive regressor guidance then closes the loop by repeatedly measuring R ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) − c R(\mathbf{x})-c on the clean-image estimate and applying a gradient-normalized, noise-weighted correction that shrinks with the remaining error. We write R R -MAE for the mean of | R ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) − c | |R(\mathbf{x})-c| over a stated grid of targets and seeds.
blocks.zh: 分数Dial将这些收视率变成闭路生成器. 一个被冷冻的预受训练的视觉骨干和一个与人类收视率相适应的线性脊头组成了可分化的后退器R R ;而一个被预受训练的传播模型则被适应于每个图像域. 目标配置,与域名LORA联合培训R-pseudo标签图像,将cc注入每个变压器块并位置生成开放. 然后通过在清真图像估计上反复测量 R Q (x)- c R (\ mathbf{x})- c 并应用梯度常态化,噪声加权的校正来收缩循环. 我们写 R-MAE 的平均值为 | R- (x)- c- | R(\ mathbf{x})- c- | , 覆盖一个已声明的目标和种子网格 。

blocks.en: Because R R also drives sampling, low R R -MAE establishes controller agreement but not by itself perceptual change. Training-free loss-based guidance can be more susceptible to adversarial gradients than classifier guidance [ 33 ] , and learned objectives can be over-optimized [ 20 , 10 , 42 ] . We therefore separate target agreement under R R from attribute movement , assessed by matched sweeps, an independent auditor using the same ratings but a backbone absent from all deployed regressors, and blinded human judgments.
blocks.zh: 由于R R也驱动采样,低R-MAE建立控制器协议,但本身并不能感知到变化. 与分类指导[33]相比,无培训损失指导更容易受到对抗梯度的影响,学到的目标可能过于优化[20、10、42]。 因此,我们把R下的目标协议与属性运动分开,通过相应的扫描评估,独立审计师使用相同的评级,但在所有部署的倒退者中缺乏骨干,并无视人的判断。

blocks.en:
Contributions. (1) We formulate and evaluate requested-value generation for task-specific human-rated visual attributes with only 100–479 rated images per attribute.
(2) We introduce ScoreDial , which couples learned target conditioning with error-adaptive regressor feedback so that generation is first positioned by c c and then corrected according to the realized score error.
(3) Across four disparate attributes, we show empirically that convergence under the guidance regressor R R and movement of the intended attribute are not interchangeable: MPGD-flow, and ScoreDial’s own feedback without target conditioning, reach the requested values under R R but move the attribute less than ScoreDial, which has the largest auditor displacement among the compared methods on all four attributes. Blinded ratings on tire and soap confirm that mean perceived levels track c c , and in forced-choice judgments raters chose ScoreDial’s progression as the clearer one in at least 84% of comparisons with every baseline.
blocks.zh:
捐款。 (1)我们为任务特定的人类评级的视觉属性制定和评价所请求的价值生成,每个属性只有100-479个评级图像.
(2)我们引入了分数分数(ScoreDial),夫妇通过错误适应后退回器反馈来学习了目标调节,使生成先被c定位,再根据已实现的分数分数错误进行校正.
(3) 在四个不同的属性中,我们从经验上表明,在RR 指引下趋同和预期属性的移动是不能互换的:MPGD-flow和ScoreDial本身的反馈没有目标条件,在RR下达到要求的值,但移动的属性小于ScoreDial,在所有四个属性的比较方法中,ScoreDial是最大的审计员置换. 对轮胎和肥皂的盲目收视率证实了C轨道c的感知水平,在强制选择判断中,评分者选择了ScoreDial的进取率,认为至少84%的比照率更清晰。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Human-rated objectives in design and affective generation. Human ratings have also shaped design-generation pipelines. Burnap et al. predict consumer aesthetic scores and automatically generate product designs [ 4 ] ; Hayakawa et al. train StyleGAN on tread images in the top 40% under a slip-resistance regressor [ 22 ] ; Yang et al. score and filter diffusion-generated products with a Kansei predictor [ 37 ] . Ibarrola et al. instead target requested valence–arousal–dominance values using an affect predictor trained from 13,913 rated words and 1,194 rated images [ 27 ] . Their optimization-based generators include affect-prediction error in the objective, while their Stable Diffusion procedure optimizes text-conditioning embeddings for the requested affect. ScoreDial targets task-specific scales learned from a few hundred rated images and repeatedly corrects the realized image score during sampling.
blocks.zh: 在设计和情感生成方面被人类评级的目标. 人类的评级也塑造了设计-生成管道. Burnap等人预测消费者审美分数并自动生成产品设计[4];Hayakawa等列车 Style 在滑行阻力后退器下,履带图像的GAN在前40%; 杨等. 得分和滤波传播生成出出有坎塞预测器的产品 [37]. Ibarrola等人则要求使用13,913个被评分的单词和1,194个被评分的图像所训练的撞击预测器的值。 其基于优化的生成器包括目标中的影响预测错误,而其稳定分化程序则为所请求的影响优化了文本调制嵌入. 分数 从几百个被评分的图像中学习到的拨号目标任务特有尺度,并在取样过程中再三纠正已实现的图像分数.

blocks.en: Continuous scalar-conditioned generation. CcGAN [ 13 , 14 ] , CCDM [ 15 ] , and iCCDM [ 16 ] learn image generators conditioned on continuous scalar regression labels. Their published evaluation protocols use regressors trained on real images to measure label consistency after generation, but their sampling procedures do not feed the predicted label error back to update each sample. Att-Adapter adapts a pretrained diffusion model for continuous multi-attribute control using 16,336 face images, whose attributes come from landmarks and pretrained face estimators, and 2,030 car images [ 8 ] . CompSlider turns sixteen attribute values, obtained from attribute classifiers over roughly three million training images, into the conditioning a frozen text-to-image model consumes [ 43 ] . Our conditioning stage follows the same principle, but its pseudo-labels come from an R R fitted to only 100–479 human-rated images rather than the much larger labeled sets these methods use, and it is paired at inference with feedback based on R ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) − c R(\mathbf{x})-c .
blocks.zh: 连续有分级条件的生成. CcGAN [13, 14], CCDM [15], 和 iCCDM [16] 学习以连续平面回归标签为条件的图像生成器. 他们公布的评价协议使用经过真实图像训练的回溯器来测量生成后的标签一致性,但他们的采样程序并没有反馈预测的标签错误来更新每个样本. Att-Adapter使用16,336张面相图像,调整了预受训练的多属性控制模式,其属性出自地标和预受训练的面相估计器,以及2,030个汽车图像 [8]. CompSlider将16个属性值从属性分类器获得,大约超过300万个训练图像,变成一个被冻结的文本到图像模型消耗 [43]. 我们的调制阶段遵循同样的原理,但其伪标签来自只装有100至479人级图像的R-R,而不是这些方法使用的大得多的标注集,它与基于R-(x)-c R(\mathb{x}-c)的反馈相配。

blocks.en: Intensity controls and sliders. AttriCtrl maps concrete attributes and vision–language-derived quantities to a unified [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] scale and injects user values through learned encoders with a frozen diffusion backbone [ 6 ] . Slider methods instead learn or identify continuous directions in model parameters, text embeddings, or latent representations [ 19 , 2 , 7 , 18 , 40 , 39 ] ; their coefficients are not fitted to ratings of a task-specific human attribute. Across these works, reported attribute change is scored by vision–language models: Δ \Delta CLIP [ 19 , 18 , 2 , 7 ] , CLIP/SigLIP/BLIP similarity [ 40 ] , or a multimodal language model [ 39 ] , rather than ratings of that attribute.
blocks.zh: 强度控制和滑动器。 AttriCtrl将混凝土属性和视觉-语言衍生出的数量映射到一个统一的 [0, 1] [0,1] 比例尺,并通过有冷冻扩散主干线的已学编码器注入用户值 [6]. 相反,滑动方法在模型参数、文字嵌入或潜在表示[19、2、7、18、40、39]中学习或确定连续方向;其系数不适应特定任务人类属性的评级。 在这些作品中,所报告的属性变化按视觉-语言模型得分:\\Delta CLIP [19, 18, 2, 7],CLIP/SigLIP/BLIP相似性[40],或多模式语言模型[39],而不是对该属性的评级.

blocks.en: Inference-time guidance and reliability. Universal Guidance [ 1 ] and MPGD [ 23 ] inject differentiable objectives during diffusion sampling. Related guidance methods include DPS [ 9 ] , LGD [ 35 ] , and TFG [ 38 ] . Gebhardt et al. use a learned regressor to guide image editing [ 21 ] , whereas ScoreDial generates from noise. Our sampler adapts MPGD-LDM’s clean-estimate update and Universal Guidance’s stepwise refinement, but makes the correction magnitude depend explicitly on the current absolute score error and pairs this feedback stage with learned target conditioning.
blocks.zh: 推论时间指导与可靠性. 通用指导[1]和MPGD[23]在扩散取样过程中注入不同的目标。 相关的指导方法包括DPS[9]、LGD[35]和过渡政府[38]。 Gebhardt等 (英语). 使用学习到的后退器来引导图像编辑 [21],而分数Dial则由噪音生成. 我们的采样器适应了 MPGD-LDM 的清洁估计更新和Universal Guide 的相继完善,但使校正的分数明确取决于当前的绝对分数错误,并将这个反馈阶段与学到的目标条件相配.

(A) A frozen pretrained visual backbone and a fitted linear ridge head form the differentiable attribute regressor R R . (B) A learned embedding of the requested value c c is injected into every transformer block and trained jointly with a domain LoRA, providing open-loop target conditioning. During active guidance steps, R R evaluates the decoded clean estimate; the squared-error gradient is normalized, and the clean latent is corrected with a step size determined by the current error and noise level.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: ScoreDial first fits a differentiable regressor R R to human ratings (Sec. 3.1 ), then combines target conditioning that places generation near c c (Sec. 3.2 ) with error-adaptive guidance that closes the residual gap during sampling (Sec. 3.3 ; Fig. 2 ). Both operate on R R ’s scale.
blocks.zh: 分分数Dial首先适合可分数回转R到人分数(Sec. 3.1),然后将目标条件将生成靠近c(Sec. 3.2)与在采样过程中关闭剩余差距的错误适应取向(Sec. 3.3;图2)结合起来. 两者都按RR的规模运作。

blocks.en: 3.1 Attribute regressor from few labels
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 从少数标签属性递归符

We consider seven backbone–representation candidates: for base DINOv2 and DINOv3 [ 29 , 34 ] (excluding register tokens), the class token, patch-token mean, and their concatenation; for CLIP ViT-B/16 [ 31 ] , the projected pooled representation. Selection and guidance use identical preprocessing: RGB [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , bicubic short-edge resize to 256, 224 × 224 224\times 224 center crop, and pretrained normalization (Sec. 4.2 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 Domain adaptation and target conditioning
blocks.zh: 3.2 领域适应和目标条件

blocks.en: The generator is the official Stable Diffusion 3.5-medium release, whose rectified-flow transformer follows SD3 [ 17 ] . 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3.5-medium ; we use revision b940f670 . A single LoRA [ 25 ] adapts the transformer to each image domain and is trained jointly with the target-value embedding below; Sec. 4.1 specifies the fixed training pools.

These labels supervise joint flow-matching training of the LoRA and value embedding; no additional human ratings are used. The embedding’s last layer is zero-initialized and is present at every denoising step. This path is open-loop: it sees c c but not the current sample’s score, leaving residual error for feedback.

blocks.en: 3.3 Error-adaptive regressor guidance
blocks.zh: 3.3 适应错误的后退器指导

blocks.en: We test whether ScoreDial reaches requested values and moves the corresponding attribute (Sec. 4.3 ), which components supply precision and movement (Sec. 4.4 ), and whether people perceive the requested progression, also relative to the baselines (Sec. 4.5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们测试ScoreDial是否达到所要求的值并移动相应的属性(Sec.4.3),哪个组件提供精度和移动(Sec.4.4),以及人们是否察觉到所要求的进展,也相对于基线(Sec.4.5.).

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: Source supervision. We evaluate four attributes with different semantics and rating protocols. Tire slip resistance uses five-point Likert ratings from Hayakawa et al. [ 22 ] . Their 120 tread entries contain one duplicated image with conflicting means; dropping both entries leaves 118 rated images . Interior visual complexity uses the complete 100-image Interior Design category of SAVOIAS [ 32 ] , whose 0–100 scores were derived by the dataset authors from crowdsourced pairwise comparisons using Bradley–Terry and matrix completion. Food desire-to-eat uses the 479 CROCUFID images with 0–100 visual-analogue ratings [ 36 ] . Soap translucency uses the 150 real photographs rated on seven-point scales by Liao et al. [ 28 ] , excluding their 150 model-generated soap images; following their protocol, we min–max normalize each observer’s ratings and then average across observers.

blocks.en: Generator-training images. Domain adaptation and target conditioning share one image pool per attribute: 984 tires, 100 interiors, 479 foods, and 800 soaps. The tire pool begins with all 534 unique tread images in the patent-sourced archive of Hayakawa et al. [ 22 ] ; the 535-file archive contains one exact byte-level duplicate, and 118 unique images carry ratings. For generator training only, the original patent line drawings of these treads are upsampled to 1024 2 1024^{2} with Topaz Gigapixel, median-filtered with a 7 × 7 7\times 7 window, and standardized per image to mean 128 and standard deviation 55, clipped to [ 0,255 ] [0,255] . R R is always fitted to the rated archive images, and no upsampled image enters a reported measurement. To reduce rendering artifacts observed at extreme-score tire targets, we oversample the score tails deterministically: using deployed- R R scores of the archive images, horizontal, vertical, and both-axis flips are added for every image with score ≤ 0.252 \leq 0.252 (65 images) or ≥ 0.746 \geq 0.746 (85 images), producing 984 training images. Interior and food use exactly their rated sets for generator training. The 800 soaps are sampled uniformly at random from the 8,085-photograph Translucent Image Dataset [ 28 ] before scoring. An SSCD copy-detection check [ 30 ] finds no reported image unusually close to its generator-training pool (supplementary material).

blocks.en: Training and sampling. We use Stable Diffusion 3.5-medium through Hugging Face diffusers in PyTorch on one NVIDIA RTX 5090. The fixed domain prompts are “a tire tread pattern, top-down view, grayscale,” “a photograph of a room interior,” “a plate of food on white background,” and “a bar of soap.” For tire/interior/food/soap respectively, a rank-32 LoRA on the transformer’s attention projections and the target-value embedding are trained jointly for 3,000/3,000/2,000/6,000 flow-matching steps, with batch 4, AdamW at constant learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and horizontal-flip probability 0.5. blocks.en: ScoreDial target agreement. A requested value is counted as reached when | R ⁡ ( 𝐱 ) − c | ≤ 0.05 |R(\mathbf{x})-c|\leq 0.05{} . ScoreDial reaches every tested cell. Across the 200 target–seed cells, the median error is at most 0.0124, the 90th percentile at most 0.0224, and the largest single-cell error is 0.0331 on food. blocks.en: Guidance-strength selection. Strengths are chosen using ten seeds disjoint from all test seeds. For each guidance baseline we search { 1 , 3 , 10 , 30 , 100 , 300 } \{1,3,10,30,100,300\} at endpoints 0.1 and 0.9 and choose the lowest endpoint R R -MAE among settings that still produce images of the domain; endpoint selection yields one fixed coefficient for the full requested range. MPGD-flow selects 100/30/30/10 for tire/interior/food/soap, each strictly inside the ladder, with error increasing on both neighboring sides. UG-flow’s error decreases at every rung, but strengths from 100 upward produce hard-edged color blocks rather than domain images for every attribute. We therefore report UG-flow at 30, the strongest domain-valid rung and hence the lowest-error eligible setting. This rule optimizes target agreement alone. UG-flow’s selected rung is already its strongest domain-valid one, whereas MPGD-flow’s lies inside the ladder, so a stronger setting could trade agreement for movement. We thus also report MPGD-flow one rung stronger, at 300/100/100/30 (MPGD-flow + ), a setting less restrictive in the precision/movement trade-off.

MPGD-flow thus exposes the central failure mode: reaching the requested value under R R does not imply comparable movement under an independent predictor of the same human-rated attribute. A stronger setting does not close this gap: MPGD-flow + has larger auditor displacement than MPGD-flow on every attribute but gives up target agreement (Table 1 ), and its displacement remains below ScoreDial’s on all four.

blocks.en: UG-flow shows the complementary failure mode: substantial movement without reaching the requested values under R R . Its interior sweep also changes scene content between neighboring targets—washbasin, kitchen, living room—whereas ScoreDial keeps one room and changes its complexity. blocks.en: 4.5 Human evaluation

blocks.en: We finally ask whether direct human perception follows the requested value. We run the same blinded protocol on tire and soap. For each attribute, 15 raters score 40 ScoreDial images (five requested values × \times eight seeds) without seeing the target. Ratings use the source scale for that attribute: 5 points for tire slip resistance [ 22 ] (1: looks easy to slip; 5: looks difficult to slip) and 7 points for soap translucency [ 28 ] (1: low; 7: high). Each participant sees 48 randomized presentations including 8 blinded repeats.
blocks.zh: 我们最后问,人类的直接认知是否遵循所要求的价值。 我们在轮胎和肥皂上做了同样失明的程序 对于每个属性,15个分数者得分40分分分数图像(5个要求的值×\时有8个种子)而未看到目标. 评分使用源尺度来表示该属性:轮胎滑行阻力5分 [22] (1:看起来容易滑行;5:看起来难以滑行)和肥皂透明性7分 (1:低;7:高). 每个参与者都看到48个随机演示,包括8个被蒙蔽的重复.

blocks.en: Participation is voluntary with informed consent; identifiers are pseudonymized, and no demographic or sensitive data are collected. R R is never shown to raters and plays no role in rating collection. Before analysis, a rater would be excluded for using at most two distinct values or for mean absolute repeat discrepancy above two points; no rater meets either criterion in either study. Repeated presentations are averaged within rater and then across raters for each image. Mean human ratings track c c in both studies: tire gives linear R 2 = 0.665 R^{2}=0.665 and tie-corrected Spearman ρ = 0.827 \rho=0.827 , while soap gives R 2 = 0.786 R^{2}=0.786 and ρ = 0.860 \rho=0.860 .

blocks.en: Forced-choice comparison with baselines. The rating studies cover ScoreDial alone, so we compare perceived progression with the baselines in a two-alternative forced-choice (2AFC) study on tire and soap, with the same recruitment and consent. Each screen shows two rows of five images generated from the same test seed at c = 0.1 , … , 0.9 c=0.1,\ldots,0.9 from left to right: one row from ScoreDial and one from Numeric prompt, MPGD-flow, MPGD-flow + , or UG-flow, giving 40 pairs over the four baselines and ten test seeds. Raters are told that both rows request an increasing level from left to right and choose the row that becomes more clearly slip-resistant (tire) or translucent (soap), judging the change rather than image quality; there is no tie option. ScoreDial’s row is on top in a random half of the pairs for each rater, and 8 pairs are repeated with the rows swapped. Under criteria fixed before analysis, a rater is excluded for giving the same answer on every screen or for choosing the same method on a repeat and its original in at most 3 of the 8 repeats, leaving 15 tire and 15 soap raters. Table 3 reports the fraction of non-repeat judgments preferring ScoreDial. ScoreDial is preferred in 84–98% of judgments across baselines and attributes.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: ScoreDial couples learned target conditioning with error-adaptive feedback for requested-value control from a few hundred human ratings. One sampler configuration reaches every tested cell on all four attributes ( R R -MAE ≤ {}\leq{} 0.013, ρ = 0.980 \rho=0.980 ). Crucially, agreement with the guidance regressor R R is not equivalent to attribute control: MPGD-flow also reaches the requested values under R R , while ScoreDial has larger independent-auditor displacement on every attribute, even against a stronger MPGD-flow setting, and the largest among all compared methods. On every attribute, feedback-only retains low R R error while auditor displacement drops by more than half, whereas conditioning-only lacks accurate requested-value agreement. Blinded human studies on tire and soap show mean ratings tracking c c , and in forced-choice comparisons raters chose ScoreDial’s progression as the clearer one in at least 84% of judgments against every baseline. Code and generation manifests are available at https://github.com/Kamijo-Gen/ScoreDial .

blocks.en: A Autoencoder round-trip check
blocks.zh: 自动编码器往返检查

blocks.en: Section 3.3 of the main paper states that, on the rated images, the frozen autoencoder path alone changes R R by at most 1.84% of the control range. Each of the 847 rated images (118 tire, 100 interior, 479 food, 150 soap) is resized to 1024 2 1024^{2} , encoded and decoded by the frozen SD3.5 autoencoder used during sampling, and scored by the deployed R R before and after. Before running, we fixed the criterion that the round trip is negligible for an attribute if the mean | Δ ​ R | |\Delta R| is below 5% of the control range (0.8, the width of the requested values 0.1 0.1 – 0.9 0.9 ) and the Pearson correlation between the two scores is at least 0.99. The mean | Δ ​ R | |\Delta R| is 0.91%, 1.83%, 1.16%, and 0.42% of the range for tire, interior, food, and soap, with r ≥ 0.9986 r\geq 0.9986 , so every attribute meets the criterion. As a reference, pairing each original with a randomly permuted reconstruction gives the | Δ ​ R | |\Delta R| between unrelated images of the same attribute; the actual round-trip shift is at most 6% of that value. The check isolates the decoder path; attribute movement is evaluated separately in Section 4.3 of the main paper.

blocks.en: B Training-pool memorization check
blocks.zh: B. 培训-集合记忆检查

blocks.en: Section 4.1 of the main paper states that an SSCD copy-detection check finds no reported image unusually close to its generator-training pool. For each attribute we take the 50 reported ScoreDial images (the Full cells of Tables 1 and 2) and the generator-training pool of Section 4.1, embed both with the released SSCD descriptor sscd_disc_mixup (Pizzi et al., CVPR 2022), and measure cosine similarity. Each generated image is matched to its nearest training image. As a reference, each training image’s nearest neighbour within the pool, excluding itself, gives the similarity the pool already reaches internally. Table S1 lists the results: on every attribute, even the closest generated image lies inside the pool’s own nearest-neighbour distribution, at its 15th–74th percentile. The tire pool contains flipped copies of its tail images (Section 4.1), which raises its internal similarity.

blocks.en: C Regressor-selection protocol
blocks.zh: 回归者选择协议

blocks.en: Section 4.2 of the main paper reports repeated nested cross-validation of the full selection procedure. In each of five repeats, the labelled images are split into five outer folds. Within each outer-training split, a five-fold inner cross-validation scores all 28 configurations, the seven backbone–representation candidates of Section 3.1 combined with ridge α ∈ { 1 , 10 , 50 , 100 } \alpha\in\{1,10,50,100\} , and keeps the one with the highest inner R 2 R^{2} . That configuration is refit on the outer-training split and predicts the held-out outer fold. Each repeat yields one R 2 R^{2} over all outer predictions, and the main paper reports their mean ± \pm SD. These scores estimate the selection procedure as a whole: the configurations chosen in the outer folds are recorded only to inspect their stability and do not choose the deployed regressor, which is selected separately as described in Section 4.2.
